id.description: Made by the SDK. A resent item keeps its id and is not counted twice.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time with a time zone: 'Z' or an offset, upper-case 'T' and 'Z'. The server also refuses dates that do not exist (February 31st), which the pattern cannot. Items more than 1 hour ahead of the server clock or older than 7 days (400 days on POST /v1/import) are refused as stale_item, which a schema cannot express.

attributes.description: Flat map, at most 20 entries. Never prompts, responses, user ids, e-mail addresses or IP addresses.
